summary.text: Melissa Hardy is a Republican Nevada Assembly member from District 22 who has served since November 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Hardy was born in Las Vegas, Nevada, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, in 2010.
Her career experience includes working as a real estate agent, owning a Port of Subs franchise, and working in the Clark County court system and for various Nevada law firms.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she was inspired to public service by her parents; her father, Mel Close, served as Assembly Speaker and in the Nevada State Senate.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Education, and Judiciary committees.
